refusals.refusal_text: I ran multiple targeted searches (HHS + PHIPA/privacy breach, IPC decisions/news releases, ransomware/cyberattack angles, CBC Hamilton, Global News, Hamilton Spectator) specifically scoped to January 16, 2026 – July 16, 2026 for Hamilton Health Sciences Corporation. I did not find any news items — from HHS's own newsroom, the IPC, or media outlets — reporting a PHIPA-related incident, breach, IPC decision, complaint, or enforcement action involving HHS within that window.
